headline: Learned and constraint-based methods resolve conformational states of biomolecules
label: Conformational Heterogeneity And Rigidity
summary: Cryo-EM, diffusion, and steered MD tools now quantify protein conformational states and ensembles directly from structural data.
synthesis: The dominant thread is computational characterization of conformational states and ensembles in biomolecular structures using learned and physics-informed methods. Point Transformer applied to cryo-EM data targets protein conformational heterogeneity, and DEMO-EMReF uses hybrid spatial and channel attention to refine density maps and improve map-model correlation. Rigid protein fiducials, obtained through generative design and deep-learning ensemble prediction, enable cryoEM visualization of GPCR conformational states, validated on four GPCRs. On the sampling side, distance-restraint-guided diffusion extends Boltz-2 to conformational changes and ligand dissociation pathways, while DiffEnsemble generates conformational ensembles that outperform BioEmu and AlphaFLOW. PySteMoDA adds automated analysis of steered molecular dynamics data. The new element is the treatment of conformational states and ensembles as outputs of generative and attention-based models.
